color.note: The four brand colours plus white and black, and the roles they play on the website. The website is white with Deep Teal text; Teal is the hover and focus colour and the fill behind nothing large; Soft Green draws the lines, leaves and rules. Use only these six colours: no tints, no greys, no other hues.

tokens.name: deep-teal
tokens.usage: Brand main colour. On the website: all text and headings on white, the filled button, outlines, the footer band and the logo. 12.15:1 with white, 10.28:1 with Pale Neutral.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Hover and focus colour: links and buttons turn Teal on hover, the focus ring is Teal. Also small marks (the open-now dot). 4.93:1 with white, so it may carry text where it must.

tokens.name: soft-green
tokens.usage: Brand accent: leaves, highlights, card borders and rules. Text only on Deep Teal (5.64:1). Never text on white (2.15:1) or Pale Neutral (1.82:1).

tokens.name: pale-neutral
tokens.usage: Brand background colour for the occasional panel or card band, used sparingly.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background, most of every page; and text on Deep Teal and Teal.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Only for one-colour printing and the black logo files. Not used on the website.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the ground of almost every section.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Used sparingly: at most one or two panels or bands per page. Text on it: text-strong (10.28:1).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Used sparingly: the footer, and at most one small feature band. Text on it: text-on-inverse; accents: text-accent-on-inverse.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface and surface-alt (Deep Teal: 12.15:1 and 10.28:1).

tokens.name: text-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface-inverse (12.15:1) and on teal fills (4.93:1).

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Same as text (kept for compatibility): Deep Teal on surface-alt panels and small print.

tokens.name: text-accent-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Labels, subheads and highlights on surface-inverse (5.64:1). Never on surface or surface-alt.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on surface and surface-alt, always underlined (Deep Teal). On hover: link-hover.

tokens.name: link-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Links on surface-inverse, always underlined (12.15:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative lines only: card borders, table rules, dividers (1px). Not for form fields or anything a person must see to use the page (2.15:1 on white).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, form fields and other control borders, 2px (Deep Teal).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on surface and surface-alt: 3px solid Teal, 3px offset (4.93:1).

tokens.name: focus-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on surface-inverse: 3px solid, 2px offset (5.64:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Filled button on surface and surface-alt (Deep Teal). Label: on-action (12.15:1).

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Filled button on hover and while pressed (Teal). Label: on-action (4.93:1).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on action and action-hover fills.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Links, menu items and outline buttons on hover and while pressed (Teal, 4.93:1 on white).

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: One per page: the page's main heading.

styles.name: intro
styles.sample: Book an appointment, walk in, or call us.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a page or section heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Our family doctors and nurses are here for every age.
styles.usage: All running text. Never smaller for body copy.

styles.name: menu
styles.usage: Main navigation links, desktop and mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, small headings above lists, captions that name something.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: The smallest text anywhere: footnotes, legal lines, image credits.

styles.name: intro-mobile
styles.sample: Book an appointment, walk in, or call us.

styles.name: body-mobile
styles.sample: Our family doctors and nurses are here for every age.

spacing.note: An 8px-based scale for the website. The brand guidelines set no spacing, so these steps are proposed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: an icon to a small badge edge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between lines of a tight group, such as a label and its hint.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: An icon to its label; a leaf marker to its list text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; a label to its field; between list items.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the gutter between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button side padding; card padding on desktop; a heading to its text.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; page side margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section top and bottom padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tiles, cards, panels, form fields and photos: one corner for everything (chosen 30 Sept 2026 after comparing square, 4px and 8px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Same as radius-sm; kept so older files keep working.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circles only: the video ring, provider photos, the step numbers and the open-now dot.

size.note: Layout and accessibility sizes. The measure keeps lines under 75 characters, as the brand guidelines ask for older readers.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Widest content area (header, sections, footer), centred, with page-gutter padding each side: 100px to the screen edge at 1440px, which sits in the middle of the range measured on One Medical, Spring, Cleveland Clinic and Tia.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Widest block of running text (about 70 characters of body).

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Smallest height and width of anything a person taps or clicks.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Height of every button (space-4 padding around a 24px line).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Smallest icon size allowed; icons in buttons, text links and lists.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons beside menu items and contact details.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons on service cards.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every section on screens 768px and wider.

tokens.name: page-gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side padding of every section on phones.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the sticky header (logo 260px wide, 12px above and below).

tokens.name: phone-bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the phone Book / Call bar fixed at the bottom of the screen.

tokens.name: border-width-card
tokens.usage: Card and table borders in border.

tokens.name: border-width-control
tokens.usage: Form fields and the secondary button border.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring width.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus ring.
